headings: Efficiencies and Reducing Our Carbon Footprint
paragraphs: As America's supercharged Un-carrier, we have disrupted the telecommunications industry by actively engaging with and listening to our customers and focusing on eliminating their pain points. Our customers benefit from what we believe is an unmatched combination of the best value and best network, alongside an unwavering focus on offering them the best possible service experience and an undisputable drive for disruptive innovation in wireless and beyond. This includes providing added value and what we believe is an exceptional experience while implementing signature Un-carrier initiatives that have changed the industry. We ended annual service contracts, overages, unpredictable international roaming fees and data buckets, among other things. We are inspired by a relentless focus on customer experience, consistently delivering award-winning customer experience, which drives our customer satisfaction levels while enabling operational efficiencies.

With what we believe is America's best network, with the largest, fastest, most awarded and most advanced 5G network, the Un-carrier strives to offer customers unrivaled coverage and capacity where they live, work and travel. We believe our network is the foundation of our success and powers everything we do. Our dense and multi-layer network provides an unmatched 5G and overall network experience to our customers, which consists of our foundational layer of low-band, mid-band and millimeter-wave ("mmWave") spectrum licenses (see "Spectrum Position" below). This multilayer portfolio of spectrum broadens and deepens our nationwide 5G network, enabling accelerated innovation and increased competition in the U.S. wireless telecommunications industry.

We continue to expand the footprint and improve the quality of our network, enabling us to provide what we believe are outstanding wireless experiences for customers who should not have to compromise on quality and value. Our network allows us to deliver new, innovative products and services, such as our 5G broadband fixed wireless product, with the same customer experience focus and industry-disrupting mindset that we have adopted in our journey to redefine wireless communications services in the United States in the customers' favor.

As part of our relentless, customer-first focus, we are transforming into an AI-enabled, data-informed, digital-first organization to continue delivering differentiated experiences to our customers. Leveraging the latest AI technology and digital capabilities, we are pioneering new approaches to serving customers with a platform to better anticipate and proactively solve their issues, offering personalized self-service options and taking authorized actions on their behalf, while simultaneously creating large-format customer experience stores for customers looking for an immersive experience. Our comprehensive T-Life app is radically simplifying customer experiences with upgrades, add-a-line, and switching transactions all available at customers' fingertips, allowing customers and prospects to transact with us wherever and whenever they want.

As of December 31, 2025, we provide wireless communications and broadband services to 142.4 million postpaid and prepaid customers and generate revenue by providing affordable wireless communications and broadband services to these customers, as well as a wide selection of wireless devices and accessories. We also provide wholesale wireless services to various partners, who then offer the services for sale to their customers. Our most significant expenses relate to operating and expanding our network, providing a full range of devices, acquiring and retaining high-quality customers and compensating employees. We provide services, devices and accessories across our flagship brands, T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile and Mint Mobile, through our T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile owned and operated retail stores, as well as through our websites (www.t-mobile.com, www.metrobyt-mobile.com and www.mintmobile.com), T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile and Mint Mobile apps, customer care channels and through national retailers. In addition, we sell devices to dealers and other third-party distributors for resale through independent third-party retail outlets and a variety of third-party websites. The information on our websites is not part of this Form 10-K. See Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations for additional information.

We provide wireless communications and broadband services through a variety of service plan options. We also offer for sale to customers a wide selection of wireless devices, including smartphones, wearables, tablets, 5G broadband gateways and other mobile communication devices that are manufactured by various suppliers.

We offer a full suite of service plans that provide customers with the features that meet their lifestyle and daily needs. Our most popular current service plan offerings are our premium Experience plans, including Experience More and Experience Beyond, which include unlimited talk, text and data on our network, 5G access at no extra cost, scam protection features, popular streaming subscriptions, in-flight Wi-Fi, access to the same device offers as new customers and more. We also offer an Essentials rate plan for customers who want the basics at a lower price point, and specific rate plans to qualifying customers, including Military and Veterans, First Responder and 55+.

At the time of device purchase, qualified customers can finance all or a portion of the individual device or accessory purchase price over an installment period, generally of 24 months, using an equipment installment plan ("EIP").

In addition to our wireless communications services, we offer complementary broadband services including 5G broadband, which is a fixed wireless product available to tens of millions of domestic households utilizing the excess capacity of our nationwide 5G network, and fiber, expanding broadband access and choices for some consumers. With our 5G broadband and fiber plans, customers can access the internet without worrying about annual service contracts, data overages or hidden fees.
We also provide products and services that are complementary to our wireless communications and broadband services, including device protection, financial services and advertising.
We provide wireless communications and broadband services to a variety of customers needing connectivity, but focus primarily on two categories of customers:

•Postpaid customers generally are qualified to pay after receiving service utilizing phones, 5G broadband gateways, fiber connections, mobile internet devices (including tablets and hotspots), wearables, DIGITS and other connected devices (including SyncUP and internet of things ("IoT")). We serve consumers as well as business customers, who are provided services under the T-Mobile for Business brand.
•Prepaid customers generally pay for service in advance. We serve prepaid customers under the T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, Mint Mobile and Ultra Mobile brands.

We also provide Machine-to-Machine ("M2M") and Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") customers access to our network. This access and the customer relationship are managed by wholesale partners, with whom we have commercial agreements permitting them to sell services utilizing our network.

headings: We operate in a highly competitive industry. If we are unable to attract and retain customers, our business, financial condition, and operating results could be negatively affected.

If we fail to adopt and deploy emerging network technologies in a timely and effective manner, our competitive position could erode, which may adversely affect our business, financial condition, and operating results.

If we fail to effectively execute our digital transformation and drive customer and employee adoption of emerging technologies, our competitive position and financial performance could be materially harmed.
System failures and business disruptions may prevent us from providing reliable service, which could materially and adversely affect our reputation and financial condition.
The scarcity and cost of additional wireless spectrum, and regulations relating to spectrum use, may adversely affect our business, financial condition, and operating results.
Any acquisition, investment, joint venture, merger, or divestiture may subject us to significant risks, any of which may harm our business.
Economic, political, and market conditions may adversely affect our business, financial condition, and operating results.
Sociopolitical volatility and polarization may adversely affect our business operations and reputation.
Our substantial level of indebtedness could adversely affect our business flexibility and ability to service our debt and could increase our borrowing costs.
Changes in credit market conditions and other factors could adversely affect our ability to raise debt favorably.
Risks Related to Legal and Regulatory Matters
Laws and regulations relating to the handling of privacy, data protection, and AI may result in increased costs, legal claims, fines, or reputational damage.
Unfavorable outcomes of legal proceedings may adversely affect our business, reputation, financial condition, cash flows, and operating results.
Our business may be adversely impacted if we are not able to protect our intellectual property rights or if we infringe on the intellectual property rights of others.
We offer regulated financial services products. These products expose us to a wide variety of state and federal regulations.
Our business may be impacted by new or amended tax laws or regulations or administrative interpretations and judicial decisions affecting the scope or application of tax laws or regulations.
Our wireless licenses are subject to renewal and may be revoked in the event that we violate applicable laws.
Risks Related to Ownership of Our Common Stock
paragraphs: In addition to the other information contained in this Form 10-K, the following risk factors should be considered carefully in evaluating T-Mobile. Our business, financial condition, liquidity, or operating results, as well as the price of our common stock and other securities, could be materially and adversely affected by any of these risks.

The telecommunications industry is highly competitive. As the industry reaches saturation, competition in all market segments, including prepaid, postpaid, enterprise and government customers will likely further intensify, putting pressure on pricing and/or margins for us and all our competitors. Our ability to attract and retain customers will depend on multiple factors, such as network quality and capacity, customer service excellence, effective marketing strategies, competitive pricing, compelling value propositions, and distribution and logistics capabilities. Additionally, targeted marketing approaches for a broad spectrum of customer segments, coupled with continuous innovation in products and services, are essential for retaining and expanding our customer base. If we are unable to successfully differentiate our services from those of our competitors, it would adversely affect our competitive position and ability to grow our business.

We expect to continue to see intense competition in all market segments from traditional Mobile Network Operators ("MNOs"), such as AT&T and Verizon, who have each invested heavily in spectrum, their wireless networks, and services and device promotions. Numerous other regional MNOs and MVNOs offering wireless services may also compete with us in some markets, including cable providers, such as Comcast, Charter, Cox, and Altice, as they continue to diversify their offerings to include wireless services offered under MVNO agreements. As new products and services emerge, we may also face competition from non-traditional competitors outside the wireless communications services industry, including satellite providers offering connectivity services using alternative technologies.

In the market for broadband services, traditional cable providers, AT&T, Verizon, and other players such as satellite and fiber providers, all compete for customers. To complement our fixed wireless service, we have entered into joint venture agreements aimed at establishing a robust fiber wireline network in certain geographic regions that we believe will complement our fixed wireless services in those areas. However, these partnerships also involve inherent risks. See "Any acquisition, investment, joint venture, merger, or divestiture may subject us to significant risks, any of which may harm our business" for further discussion of such risks.
If we are unable to compete effectively in attracting and retaining customers in markets where we operate, it could negatively affect our business, financial condition, and operating results.

We have experienced cyberattacks and may experience disruptions, data loss and other security breaches, whether directly or indirectly through third parties whose products and services we rely on in operating our business.

paragraphs: The objectives of our Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations ("MD&A") are to provide users of our consolidated financial statements with the following:
•A narrative explanation from the perspective of management of our financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, liquidity and certain other factors that may affect future results;
•Context to the consolidated financial statements; and
•Information that allows assessment of the likelihood that past performance is indicative of future performance.

Our MD&A is provided as a supplement to, and should be read together with, our audited consolidated financial statements as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, and for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2025, included in Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K. Except as expressly stated, the financial condition and results of operations discussed throughout our MD&A are those of T-Mobile US, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries.

On May 24, 2024, we entered into a securities purchase agreement with United States Cellular Corporation ("UScellular"), Telephone and Data Systems, Inc., and USCC Wireless Holdings, LLC for the acquisition of substantially all of UScellular's wireless operations and select AWS, PCS, 600 MHz, 700 MHz and other spectrum assets for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $4.4 billion, payable in cash and the assumption of up to $2.0 billion of debt through exchange offers to certain UScellular debtholders.

On May 23, 2025, we launched exchange offers (the "Exchange Offers") for any and all of certain outstanding senior notes of UScellular for new notes of T-Mobile with the same interest rate, interest payment dates, maturity dates and redemption terms as each corresponding series of senior notes of UScellular. In conjunction with the Exchange Offers, we also solicited consents for each series of the outstanding senior notes of UScellular to effect a number of amendments to the applicable indenture under which each such series of notes were issued and are governed (the "Consent Solicitations"). The consummation of the Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations were subject to the closing of the UScellular Acquisition (as defined below), which occurred on August 1, 2025.

On July 22, 2025, we entered into asset purchase agreements for the acquisition of substantially all of the wireless operations assets (together with UScellular's wireless operations and select spectrum assets, the "UScellular Wireless Business") of each of Farmers Cellular Telephone Company, Inc., Iowa RSA No. 9 Limited Partnership, and Iowa RSA No. 12 Limited Partnership (collectively, the "Iowa Entities") for an aggregate purchase price of $175 million payable in cash. Prior to our acquisition of the Iowa Entities, UScellular held a minority interest in each of the Iowa Entities.

The UScellular Wireless Business offers a comprehensive range of wireless communications products and services. As a combined company, we expect to increase competition in the telecommunications industry, achieve synergies and enhance our rural 5G coverage with our combined network footprint. Following the closing of the transactions, UScellular and the Iowa Entities will retain ownership of their other spectrum licenses, as well as their towers.

On August 1, 2025, upon the completion of certain customary closing conditions, including the receipt of certain regulatory approvals (the "UScellular Acquisition Date"), we completed the acquisition of the UScellular Wireless Business, and as a result, the UScellular Wireless Business became wholly owned by T-Mobile. In exchange, on the UScellular Acquisition Date, we transferred cash of $2.8 billion. Additionally, the closing of the UScellular Acquisition obligated us to execute the Exchange Offers. On August 5, 2025, we executed the Exchange Offers of certain senior notes of UScellular with an aggregate outstanding principal balance of $1.7 billion for T-Mobile notes with the same interest rate, interest payment dates, maturity dates and redemption terms as each corresponding series of senior notes of UScellular.
For more information regarding the UScellular Acquisition, see Note 2 – Business Combinations of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

headings: 提升效率與降低碳足跡
paragraphs: 作為美國的超強 Un-carrier，我們透過積極與客戶互動並傾聽客戶意見，並專注於消除其痛點，來顛覆電信產業。我們的客戶受益於我們認為無可比擬的組合，包括最佳價值與最佳網路，以及持續專注於提供最佳的服務體驗與在無線通訊領域及其他領域持續推動顛覆性創新。這包括在執行標誌性的 Un-carrier 初創計畫時，提供附加價值與我們認為無可比擬的體驗。我們終止年度服務合約、超額費、無法預測的國際漫遊費用與數據桶，以及其他事項。我們受到對客戶體驗持續專注的啟發，持續提供獲獎的客戶體驗，這驅動我們的客戶滿意度，同時也使我們的運營效率提升。

我們相信美國最好的網路，擁有最大、最快、獲最多獎項與最進階的 5G 網路，Un-carrier 嘗試為客戶提供無與倫比的覆蓋與容量，使其在居住、工作與旅行的地方都能享受。我們認為我們的網路是我們成功的基礎，並驅動我們所做的一切。我們密集且多層次的網路為客戶提供無可比擬的 5G 與整體網路體驗，這包括我們基礎層的低頻段、中頻段與毫米波（"mmWave"）頻譜許可證（請參閱下方 "Spectrum Position"）。這個多層次的頻譜組合擴展並深化我們的全國 5G 網路，使美國無線電信產業加速創新與增加競爭。
我們持續擴展網路的覆蓋範圍並提升其品質，使我們能為客戶提供我們認為無可比擬的無線體驗，而客戶不必妥協於品質與價值。我們的網路使我們能提供新的創新產品與服務，例如我們的 5G 寬頻固定無線產品，並以同樣的客戶體驗焦點與產業顛覆思維，重新定義美國的無線通訊服務，以符合客戶的利益。

作為我們持續專注於客戶的第一優先的事項，我們正在轉型為一個由人工智慧驅動、數據導向、以數位為先的組織，以持續為客戶提供差異化的體驗。透過最新的人工智慧技術與數位能力，我們正在開創新的方式來服務客戶，提供一個平台以更好地預測並主動解決客戶的問題，提供個性化的自助服務選項，並在客戶授權下代表其行事，同時也建立大型格式的客戶體驗商店，以供尋求沉浸式體驗的客戶使用。我們的全面 T-Life 應用程式正在大幅簡化客戶體驗，提供升級、加裝線路與轉換服務的交易功能，皆可透過客戶的手指輕觸即可完成，使客戶與潛在客戶能隨時隨地與我們進行交易。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們為 142.4 億名後付與預付客戶提供無線通訊與寬頻服務，並透過提供經濟實惠的無線通訊與寬頻服務給這些客戶，以及廣泛的無線設備與配件來產生收入。我們也為各種合作夥伴提供電信服務，這些合作夥伴再將服務銷售給其客戶。我們最重要的支出與經營與擴展我們的網路、提供完整的設備、取得與留住高品質客戶以及支付員工薪資有關。我們透過我們的旗艦品牌 T-Mobile、Metro by T-Mobile 與 Mint Mobile 提供服務、設備與配件，透過我們的 T-Mobile 與 Metro by T-Mobile 自有與經營的零售商店，以及透過我們的網站（www.t-mobile.com、www.metrobyt-mobile.com 與 www.mintmobile.com）、T-Mobile、Metro by T-Mobile 與 Mint Mobile 應用程式、客戶服務通路，以及透過全國性零售商店。此外，我們也將設備銷售給經銷商與其他第三方經銷商，供其透過獨立第三方零售商店與多種第三方網站進行轉售。我們網站上的資訊並非本 Form 10-K 的一部分。請參閱第 7 項「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果的討論與分析」以取得更多資訊。
我們透過多種服務方案提供無線通訊與寬頻服務。我們也為客戶提供廣泛的無線設備選擇，包括智慧型手機、穿戴式裝置、平板電腦、5G 寬頻門戶與其他移動通訊設備，這些設備由不同供應商製造。

我們提供完整的服務方案，以符合客戶的生活方式與日常需求。我們目前最受歡迎的服務方案為我們的 premium Experience 方案，包括 Experience More 與 Experience Beyond，這些方案包含在我們的網路中無限通話、簡訊與數據，5G 服務無額外費用，詐騙防護功能，熱門串流訂閱服務，機上 Wi-Fi，與新客戶相同的裝置優惠，以及其他功能。我們也提供 Essentials 價格方案，供想要基本功能且價格較低的客戶使用，以及針對符合資格的客戶提供的特定價格方案，包括軍人與退伍軍人、第一 responders 與 55 歲以上的客戶。
在購買設備時，符合資格的客戶可透過設備分期付款計畫（"EIP"），在 24 個月的分期期內分期償還設備或配件的購買新價。
除提供無線通訊服務外，本公司亦提供補充性寬頻服務，包括 5G 寬頻，為數以千萬計的國內家庭提供固定無線產品，利用本公司全國 5G 網路的閒置容量，以及光纖，擴大部分消費者寬頻存取與選擇。透過本公司 5G 寬頻與光纖方案，客戶可無需擔心年度服務合約、數據超額或隱藏費用即可使用網路。
本公司亦提供與無線通訊及寬頻服務相輔相成的產品與服務，包括裝置保護、財務服務與廣告。
本公司提供無線通訊與寬頻服務予多種需要連線的客戶，但主要著重於兩類客戶：
•後付客戶一般在使用電話、5G 寬頻門戶、光纖連線、行動網路裝置（包括平板電腦與熱點）、穿戴式裝置、DIGITS 以及其他連線裝置（包括 SyncUP 與物聯網（"IoT"））後支付費用。本公司同時服務消費者與企業客戶，企業客戶透過 T-Mobile for Business 品牌接受服務。
•預付客戶一般在使用服務前支付費用。預付客戶透過 T-Mobile、Metro by T-Mobile、Mint Mobile 與 Ultra Mobile 品牌接受服務。
本公司亦為機器對機器（"M2M"）與行動虛擬網路運營商（"MVNO"）客戶提供使用網路的存取權。此存取權與客戶關係由電信業者管理，本公司與電信業者有商業協議，允許電信業者銷售利用本公司網路的服務。

paragraphs: 本公司管理層討論與分析財務狀況與營運成果（"MD&A"）之目標為提供使用本公司合併財務報表之使用者以下資訊：
•從管理層觀點說明本公司財務狀況、營運成果、現金流、流動性及可能影響未來成果之其他因素之敘述性解釋；
•與合併財務報表相關之背景資訊；以及
•使使用者得以評估過去表現是否為未來表現之指標之資訊。

本公司MD&A為本公司經審計之合併財務報表之補充資料，應與本公司經審計之合併財務報表一併閱讀，該財務報表為截至2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日之財務狀況，以及2025年12月31日為期末之三年期間內各年度之財務資料，包含於本Form 10-K之第二部分，第8項。除非另有明確說明，MD&A中討論之財務狀況與營運成果為T-Mobile US, Inc.及其合併子公司之財務狀況與營運成果。

2024年5月24日，本公司與United States Cellular Corporation（"UScellular"）、Telephone and Data Systems, Inc.及USCC Wireless Holdings, LLC簽訂證券購買協議，以約44億美元總計購價，以現金支付並承擔最多20億美元債務，透過對特定UScellular債權人之交換要約，取得UScellular之無線運營及選定AWS、PCS、600 MHz、700 MHz及其他頻譜資產。

2025年5月23日，本公司發起交換要約（"交換要約"），以換取UScellular所有現有高級債券，發行T-Mobile之新債券，利率、利息支付日、到期日及贖回條款與對應之UScellular高級債券系列相同。同時，本公司亦針對UScellular所有現有高級債券系列發起同意要約（"同意要約"），以修改相關發行契約（"發行契約"）之條款。交換要約與同意要約之完成，須待UScellular收購（如後文所定）完成，該收購於2025年8月1日完成。

2025年7月22日，本公司與Farmers Cellular Telephone Company, Inc.、Iowa RSA No. 9 Limited Partnership及Iowa RSA No. 12 Limited Partnership（合稱"愛荷華實體"）簽訂資產購買協議，以總計1.75億美元現金購入愛荷華實體之無線運營資產（與UScellular之無線運營及選定頻譜資產合稱"UScellular無線業務"）。在本公司取得愛荷華實體之前，UScellular在每一家愛荷華實體中持有少數股權。
UScellular 無線通訊業務提供完整範圍的無線通訊產品與服務。作為一家合併後的公司，我們預期將增加電信業者的競爭，實現協同效益，並透過合併後的網路覆蓋範圍加強我們在鄉村地區的 5G 覆蓋。在交易完成後，UScellular 與愛荷華州實體將保留其其他頻譜許可證，以及其電塔的所有權。

2025 年 8 月 1 日，在完成某些慣例性的交易關閉條件，包括取得某些監管批准（稱為 "UScellular 收購日"）後，我們完成了對 UScellular 無線通訊業務的收購，因此 UScellular 無線通訊業務成為 T-Mobile 的 wholly owned。作為交換，我們在 UScellular 收購日轉讓現金 28 億美元。此外，UScellular 收購的關閉義務我們執行了交換要約。2025 年 8 月 5 日，我們執行了對 UScellular 某些高收益票據的交換要約，總共未償本金金額為 17 億美元，以換取 T-Mobile 同樣利率、利息支付日、到期日及贖回條款的票據。
如需更多有關 UScellular 收購的資訊，請參閱財務會計彙編附註第 2 項 – 企業合併。
與 UScellular 收購相關的合併成本至目前為止包括：
•為實現網路、零售、資訊科技及後臺作業的效率，並將客戶遷移至 T-Mobile 網路與計費系統的整合成本；
•重整成本，包括契約終止、遣散費及網路停用；

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們經營於一個高度競爭的產業。若我們無法吸引並留住客戶，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生負面影響。
若我們未能及時且有效地採用並部署新興網路技術，將可能削弱我們的競爭地位，進而對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
若我們未能有效執行數位轉型，並推動客戶與員工採用新興技術，將可能對我們的競爭地位及財務表現造成重大損害。
系統故障與業務中斷可能導致我們無法提供可靠服務，進而對我們的聲譽與財務狀況造成重大且不利的影響。
額外無線頻譜的稀缺性與取得成本，以及與頻譜使用相關的規範，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
任何收購、投資、合資企業、合併或資產處分，都可能使我們面臨重大風險，任何風險都可能對我們的業務造成損害。
經濟、政治與市場條件可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
社會政治的不穩定與極化可能不利於我們的業務運作與聲譽。
與我們負債相關的風險
我們高額的負債水平可能不利於我們的業務彈性與償還負債的能力，並可能提高我們的借款成本。
信貸市場條件的變化及其他因素可能不利於我們以有利條件籌措負債的能力。
與法律及法規事項相關的風險
有關處理隱私權、資料保護及人工智慧的法律法規可能導致成本增加、法律聲請、罰款或聲譽損害。
法律程序的不利結果可能不利於我們的業務、聲譽、財務狀況、現金流及營運成果。
若我們無法保護我們的智慧財產權或侵犯他人的智慧財產權，可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
我們提供受規範的金融服務產品。這些產品使我們面臨多種州及聯邦法規的影響。
我們的業務可能受新或修正的稅法或法規，或行政解釋及司法判決影響，這些判決可能影響稅法或法規的範圍或適用性。
我們的無線電執照需定期續約，若我們違反適用法律，該執照可能被撤銷。
與持有本公司普通股相關的風險
paragraphs: 除本 Form 10-K 所包含的其他資訊外，評估 T-Mobile 時應謹慎考慮下列風險因素。本公司業務、財務狀況、流動性或營運結果，以及本公司普通股及其他證券的價格，可能因任何這些風險而受到重大且不利的影響。

電信業為高度競爭的產業。當產業達到飽和時，所有市場區段，包括預付、後付、企業及政府客戶的競爭將可能進一步加劇，對本公司及所有競爭對手的價格與/或毛利率造成壓力。本公司吸引及留住客戶的能力將取決於多種因素，例如網路品質與容量、客戶服務卓越性、有效的行銷策略、競爭性價格、有吸引力的價值主張，以及配送與物流能力。此外，針對廣泛客戶區段的定向行銷策略，搭配持續創新產品與服務，對留住並擴大客戶羣是必要的。若本公司無法成功將服務與競爭對手區隔，將對本公司競爭地位及擴張業務的能力造成不利影響。

我們預期將持續在所有市場區段面對來自傳統行動網路運營商（"MNOs"），例如 AT&T 和 Verizon 的激烈競爭，這些運營商已各自在頻譜、無線網路及服務和裝置促銷上投入大量資金。許多其他區域性 MNOs 和 MVNOs 提供無線服務，也可能在某些市場與我們競爭，包括有線電視供應商，例如 Comcast、Charter、Cox 和 Altice，他們持續擴展其服務項目，包含透過 MVNO 協議提供的無線服務。當新產品與服務出現時，我們也可能面臨來自非傳統競爭對手的競爭，這些對手並非無線通訊服務產業的一部分，包括透過替代技術提供連線服務的衛星供應商。

在寬頻服務市場，傳統有線電視供應商、AT&T、Verizon 及其他參與者，例如衛星和光纖供應商，均為客戶競爭。為補強我們的固定無線服務，我們已與合資公司簽訂協議，旨在某些地理區域建立強固的光纖有線網路，我們認為這些區域的固定無線服務將因此得到補強。然而，這些合作夥伴關係也伴隨著內在風險。請參閱 "任何收購、投資、合資公司、合併或出售都可能使我們面臨重大風險，任何風險都可能損害我們的業務" 以進一步討論這些風險。
若我們無法在經營的市場中有效競爭以吸引及留住客戶，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成負面影響。
我們曾遭遇網路攻擊，並可能遭遇中斷、資料遺失及其他安全漏洞，無論是直接或間接透過我們經營業務所倚賴的第三方產品與服務。
